Message.MsgText: ISAM v2 Connector version version .
ISAM Initialization is successful.
ISAM Initialization failed: exception

Explanation.p: The ISAM Connector was not able to complete initialization.

OperatorResponse.p: Use the logged exception to understand what caused the problem, and correct it.

Message.MsgText: The specified Distinguished Name (secDN) does not exist: dn

Explanation.p: The import of the specified user failed, because the user could not be found.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the Distinguished Name (DN) references an existing user.

Message.MsgText: User name import is successful.
An invalid group identification or Distinguished Name was specified: dn

Explanation.p: The import of the specified group failed, because the group could not be found.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the group identification or Distinguished Name (DN) references an existing group.

Message.MsgText: Group name import is successful.
The ISAM API configuration file must be defined.

Explanation.p: The parameter ISAM API configuration file must have a value.

OperatorResponse.p: Set the parameter ISAM API configuration file to a correct file.

Message.MsgText: Error removing user userId from the group groupName: exception.

Explanation.p: An exception occurred when removing the user from the group.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the exception for more information about the problem that occurred. Determine if further action is needed.

Message.MsgText: Group groupName was not found.

Explanation.p: The group could not be found when trying to add or delete a member from the named group.

Message.MsgText: Unable to add user userId to group groupName: exception
Unable to delete user userId from group groupName: exception
Mandatory attribute name missing from Output Map.

Explanation.p: The specified mandatory attribute could not be found in the entry that was provided to the connector.

Message.MsgText: No entry found to modify.

Explanation.p: When trying to modify an entry, the current entry was not found.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the modify operation is called only when there is an entry to modify.

Message.MsgText: No entry found to delete.

Explanation.p: When trying to delete an entry, the current entry was not found.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the delete operation is called only when there is an entry to delete.

Message.MsgText: Unable to delete an entry because the naming attribute name not found in entry.

Explanation.p: When trying to delete an entry, the mandatory naming attribute was missing, and therefore the entry could not be deleted.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure that the entry contains the naming attribute.

Message.MsgText: This connector only supports the following operators: Equals, Contains, starts With and ends With

Explanation.p: The link criteria contains an unsupported operator. The connector was unable to do the search.

OperatorResponse.p: Use one of the supported operators.

Message.MsgText: Negate not supported for Link Criteria.

Explanation.p: The connector was unable to do the search because the link criteria contained a negated operation.

OperatorResponse.p: Try to write the Link Criteria without using negate.

Message.MsgText: This connector only supports searching for the naming attribute (name).

Explanation.p: The connector is only able to use the naming attribute for searching.

OperatorResponse.p: Only use the naming attribute for searching.

Message.MsgText: No Link Criteria defined.

Explanation.p: The link criteria list was empty.

OperatorResponse.p: Please provide at least one link criteria.
